notes.title: I'm trying to make the game free for self isolation help
notes.notes:
Not sure if this is possible, but I have contacted valve to ask if they could make the game free for a short period of time. So if you don't like paying for something that will be free a few days later, wait before buying this.

edit: I haven't had a response from vavle yet, so I'm assuming it's not possible. I'll try to apply the biggest discount possible.

notes.title: ZeGame OST available
notes.notes:
The official soundtrack of ZeGame is now available on bandcamp!
You can get it here.
https://zegame.bandcamp.com/album/zegame

The soundtrack might sound a bit different form what you hear in the game. That's because the soundtrack is fine tuned a lot more. The new version of the soundtrack will also appear in the game eventually.

notes.title: ZeGame Updated
notes.notes:
The first ZeGame patches are now live. Since this is a first update this patch mostly contains bug fixes. But also a couple of minor additions.

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]portal blocks now show what portal they are linked to
[*]added an option to disable swipes on touch devices
[*]added Hungarian and Swedish
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]fixed levels not being playable at all on OS X 10.9
[*]fixed the seizure message looking weird in Hebrew
[*]editing the name of a custom pack now clears the text field when it has never been edited before.
[*]the title in the level finish screen now changes font size dynamically. Words should no longer be cut off.
[*]fixed text not fitting in the buttons of a pop up dialog
[*]tweaked the angle at which the game is seen from the top.
[*]fixed iCloud support for iOS
[*]fixed a weird visual gitch on touch devices when dragging in the level selection screen and tapping the back button at the same time
[*]the position of two arrows of a setting should no longer move when changing values
[*]in level select, fixed clicking another world also selecting it
[*]increased the side screen tap margins
[*]fixed redX error message on android lite version
[*]fixed audio filters being normal in the glitch world
[*]fixed backgrounds on ios having a weird aspect ratio
[*]fixed some achievements being achieved too early
[*]fixed an issue where timers could display 1000 milliseconds. Rather than counting it as an extra second and displaying 000
[*]fixed achievement notifications popping up on ios even when an achievement was already achieved
[*]fixed loading animation being frozen/displaying for too long
[/list]

notes.title: ZeGame Is A Neat Tile-Based Puzzler With A Free Demo
notes.notes:
I know I go on a bit about puzzle games, but it’s not just because I’m fond of them. I mean, I am, obviously, but I’m also fascinated by how developers manage to consistently create unique spins on familiar formulas. Like ZeGame [official site], for example. It’s a tile-based puzzler that tasks you with guiding a green block towards a blue goal across a number of levels. At first it’s straightforward, yet it quickly snowballs into a battle of wits and nerve.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Release time and prices
notes.notes:
I'm excited to tell you that ZeGame will be released roughly 4 hours after this post.
ZeGame will be $4.99 on steam with 10% off.
You will also be able to buy ZeGame on iOS and Android.
If you want to support charity by buying ZeGame, consider buying ZeGame via the humble store. You'll receive a steam key so you are still able to play ZeGame via steam.
If you want to support the developer of ZeGame. You can buy ZeGame via the [url=http://zegame.jespertheend.com]official website[/url].
